method: per-subband harmonic-masked Lorentzian ACF fit (pipeline window_refit._fit_subband; LAG_MAX=5, COMB_SPACING=0.390625 MHz, first-fit-lag skip, 1L/2L model selection, resolution gates). alpha via weighted log-log fit of gamma vs nu, weights 1/(sigma_gamma/gamma)^2 with sigma_gamma=hypot(gamma_err, gamma_scintle_err), restricted to resolved subbands with m<=M_PHYS(1.2).

dsa_within_band.note: UNPHYSICAL (>>ALPHA_BOUNDS ceiling 6.0). Only ~10% fractional bandwidth (1321-1460 MHz) with a steep local gamma trend; a within-band slope over such a narrow lever arm is not a scaling measurement.

two_anchor_median.note: median CHIME-hi gamma@680 MHz vs median DSA gamma@1356 MHz

robustness.verdict: All variants cluster at alpha~2.5-3.4; joint single-screen null 3.13+/-0.29 (consistent scintle weighting) is stable in central value.

two_band_joint_single_screen.note: Forced single power-law across both bands: alpha=3.13+/-0.29. REJECTED single-screen hypothesis (two-screen product=21.9>>2). Reported as the null only, NOT the headline.
two_band_joint_single_screen.weighting: consistent finite-scintle error hypot(gamma_err, gamma_scintle_err) for BOTH bands (CHIME gamma_scintle_err 0.007-0.012 MHz pulled from campaign JSON; DSA 0.13-0.83 MHz). Previous 3.138+/-0.256 zeroed the CHIME scintle term; corrected value 3.133+/-0.288.

HEADLINE.framing: per-band alpha + two-screen decomposition (single joint screen rejected)

dsa_band_alpha.note: within-band slope over ~10% fractional BW is not a scaling measurement

HEADLINE.two_screen: scintillation (near screen, DSA Delta_nu_d 0.43-1.32 MHz) is DISTINCT from the pulse-broadening screen (Stage-2 thin-screen tau=0.126 ms, alpha=4); tau*Delta_nu=21.9>>2 rejects a common screen.
HEADLINE.note_joint: joint single-screen alpha (consistent weighting) = 3.13+/-0.29 — rejected null.

physical_interpretation: the joint single-screen (rejected-null) alpha = 3.13 +/- 0.29 is slightly below the Kolmogorov thin-screen expectation (4.0-4.4) but consistent within ~3sigma; it agrees with the independent CHIME-band value (3.09+/-0.99). NOTE the scattering (Stage 2) prefers a thin-screen alpha=4 in the temporal-broadening domain; the marginally shallower scintillation-bandwidth scaling may reflect either measurement scatter or a mildly non-Kolmogorov spectrum, and is not a firm tension given the uncertainties.

dsa.note: all 4 fit and resolved; sb3 (1460 MHz) m=1.69>1.2 excluded from alpha; within-band alpha unphysical -> diagnostic_only

two_band.caveat: DSA subbands span only ~10% fractional BW; the lever-arm alpha rests on the CHIME-DSA gamma ratio, which is well-determined.

OWNER_RULING_APPLIED: Standing manuscript rule (owner 2026-07-17): where the one-screen consistency test rejects a single joint alpha, report PER-BAND alphas + two-screen decomposition as the HEADLINE; the forced joint two-band alpha appears ONLY as the tested-and-rejected single-screen hypothesis. The repo test (flits.batch.analysis_logic.check_tau_deltanu_consistency) rejects a single screen for chromatica.

two_screen_consistency.test: flits.batch.analysis_logic.check_tau_deltanu_consistency: product = tau(nu_scint)*Delta_nu_d*1e3; single screen => product in [0.1,2.0] (thin 0.159, extended 1.0). product>>2 => scintillation samples a NEARER screen than the scattering screen.
two_screen_consistency.interpretation: tau*Delta_nu = 21.9 >> 2.0: the DSA-band resolved Delta_nu_d (0.67 MHz) implies a near-screen tau ~0.28 ms, far larger than the 0.033 ms pulse-broadening tau the Stage-2 scattering fit predicts at 1.4 GHz. So the scintillation and scattering sample DIFFERENT screens (nearer diffractive screen vs farther pulse-broadening screen). A single power-law gamma(nu) across 0.6-1.4 GHz is physically rejected.
two_screen_consistency.note: Consistent with the repo's standing verdict for chromatica (different_screens); the exact product differs from the archived 93.9 because this uses the fresh good-mode tau=0.126 ms (vs on-disk 0.196) but the same-screen hypothesis is rejected either way.
two_screen_consistency.implied_near_screen_tau_note: uses pipeline C1_THIN_KOLMOGOROV=1.16 (was mistakenly computed with C1~1 -> 0.239; correct value 0.2770 ms)
